Had a wonderful dining experience at Tadka Indian Restaurant in Hanoi. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of authentic Indian flavours. We tried the biryani, butter chicken, paneer dishes, naan, and tandoori items, and everything was well prepared and flavorful.

The restaurant has a warm and comfortable ambience, making it a nice place to enjoy a relaxed meal with family or friends. The location near Hanoi’s famous Train Street is also very convenient for visitors exploring the Old Quarter.

A great choice for anyone looking for authentic Indian food in Hanoi. Highly recommended!

Tadka IRH Outstanding Indian Food & Service for Our Group of 15
Aug 2026 • Business
We visited Tadka Indian Restaurant Hanoi as a group of 15 from the UK, and it was one of the highlights of our trip. From the moment we arrived, the team made us feel very welcome and looked after us exceptionally well.

The food was authentic, freshly prepared, and full of flavour. Everyone in our group enjoyed their meals, with generous portions and plenty of choices for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. The service was prompt, friendly, and well organised despite our large group.

The restaurant has a warm atmosphere and is conveniently located near Train Street, making it an ideal place to enjoy a meal while exploring Hanoi. We were impressed by the quality of the food and the genuine hospitality shown by the staff.

We would highly recommend Tadka Indian Restaurant to anyone visiting Hanoi, especially families and tour groups looking for authentic Indian cuisine. A big thank you to the entire team for making our visit so memorable. We look forward to returning on our next trip to Vietnam.
